entities.summary: Tokyo University of Marine Science and Technology , abbreviated as Kaiyodai , is a national university in Japan. The main campus is located in Minato, Tokyo and another campus is in Kōtō, Tokyo. Tokyo University of Marine Science and Technology is a university in Minato, established in 2003.
